Most home loaves come out flat. Good loaves come only from patient timing.

Two bakers look at the same dough and disagree about whether it is ready. Seven decades of practice say why.

This book gives you two habits, and they hold from one loaf to a whole bakery.

What is inside

  • The Starter. Feeding and keeping a starter.
  • The Bakery. The same habits at bakery size.

Recipes use rye and wheat.
